question: Where is the closest museum relative to the east of John Natsoulas Gallery, Davis, CA?
sql: SELECT P.poi_name, P.addr_city, P.addr_state FROM pois AS P WHERE P.tourism = 'museum' AND ST_X(P.geometry) > ST_X( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%John Natsoulas Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Davis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 ) ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%John Natsoulas Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Davis%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
